_comment: SNU-12, decided by the maintainer on 2026-11-21 (docs/memory/maintainer-decisions.md): every end of a running keep-awake session while the driver keeps running shows one short notification, the same locale key on the three OS, through a transient notice with no window to close (a Windows tray balloon, a macOS alert banner, a Linux desktop notification). A session that was not running shows nothing, and the driver's own exit stays silent. Each case lists the drivers that replay it; a cause a driver does not have names why in `not_replayed`.

not_replayed.linux: Linux holds a logind idle inhibitor instead of moving the pointer, so no user activity ends its session.

not_replayed.windows: The Windows exit does not stop a running session (SNU-11), so it has no end to tell.
